Crypto Idea

The boldest experiment in crypto

Michael Saylor, the founder of Strategy, the world's largest corporate holder of Bitcoin, has come up with something unique.

Instead of simply buying Bitcoin with the company's own money, he's building an entire financial machine that attracts outside capital and channels it into BTC purchases.

One of these instruments is STRC. Investors provide capital to the company and receive regular payouts of around 11.5% annually. The company then uses that capital to buy Bitcoin. But there's a catch.

⚙️ How it’s supposed to work

STRC — an instrument Saylor designed with the help of AI — is intended to keep its price hovering around $100.

If the price falls, the company raises the yield to attract more buyers. The price is supposed to recover. Think of it as an automatic stabilizer.

❓ Why this is interesting 

Right now, STRC is trading at roughly $83, despite its $100 target value. The yield has already been increased, but the market isn't responding the way the model was designed to.

This is the first real stress test of the entire structure. If the mechanism fails to stabilize the price, the company will either have to keep increasing payouts to investors or buy less Bitcoin.

Saylor is essentially testing one question: can financial instruments be built around a single asset indefinitely?

How to check which services you accessed through Apple ID and Google, and not lose access to them

From July 6, Russian websites and applications are required to remove the "Sign in with Google/Apple" buttons. The accounts themselves are not deleted, but access to them can be lost.

To prevent this from happening, you need to find the profiles created with Apple ID and Google, and add new ways to log in to them:
🍏 For Apple ID

On iPhone, iPad, or Mac, go to "Settings" → your name → "Sign in with Apple".

Here you can see all the applications and services that you accessed through Apple ID, as well as the substitute emails from the "Hide email" feature - save these addresses, you can use them to log in as well.
🔎 For Google Account

From any device and browser, go to myaccount.google.com/connections.

Here you can see all the applications and services where login was set up through Google.

Now log in to the necessary services through Apple/Google and add alternative login methods, such as by phone.

Today, America wakes 250 years later as a beacon of hope, a republic entrusted to its people, an idea that changed the world.

A nation worth preserving. A dream worth pursuing. A freedom defended by every generation.

Happy 250th, America! 🇺🇸

This statement focuses on Our Republic 

For years we have heard politicians referred to us as a democracy at nauseam, now finally we are here🇺🇸

President Donald J Trump
Mt Rushmore 4/3/2026
It may have even been after midnight when he said this particular quote which would have made it today our 250 birthday.... 

"A Constitution is only as strong as the people & the culture responsible for upholding it." 🇺🇸

This statement reminds me of this one...

 "A Republic, if you can keep it" 
Benjamin Franklin

This was spoken by Benjamin Franklin at the conclusion of the Constitutional Convention in 1787. When a citizen, Elizabeth Willing Powel, asked him what form of government the delegates had created, Franklin immediately replied that they had established "a republic, if you can keep it.  

This responsibility falls on all of us, we all including the Brave White Hat Patriots and our Military have worked so hard these last 10 years to save our Republic!  It had to be this way, we all had to be a part of doing this so we will never forget how close we came to losing it! We can pass these stories of our experiences on to many generations to come so they too can hold onto what's do near and dear to our hearts.... 

FREEDOM 🇺🇸

Kelly🫡
@CaptKylePatriots
